sequence: Generate the identical original synthetic state and gradients and compute one common refreshed state. Compare its fingerprint and all leaves before branching.

Feed the same frozen Grams into original and matrix-layout power functions. Compare normalized Grams, eigenvalue ranges, eigenpair residuals, orthogonality and reconstructed powers; do not compare raw eigenvectors elementwise because signs and degenerate bases vary.
Feed each power pair plus identical momentum into one common reconstruction/inner-product function. Compare inner matrices, polar outputs and final directions.
Cross-feed identical powers/inner matrices into the original and candidate downstream layouts to separate solver differences from downstream compiler/reduction effects.
Compare staged results against fused full updates on identical inputs. Stage barriers are diagnostic instrumentation, not evidence of an accepted optimization.

Keep the baseline separate zero-state initialization and refresh calls; preserve NumPy random draw order across all seven groups.
